To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

receptive grammar acquisition follows a systematic developmental order, that this order can be predicted by PT’s developmental hierarchy, and that the developmental orders obtained in receptive and productive grammar processing are very similar.

(1) receptive L2 grammar acquisition can be studied in an empirical way; (2) receptive L2 learners acquire the ability to process different morphosyndactic phenomena in a similar order to L2 productive learners; and (3) receptive L2 learner data can be used to validate the predictions of PT.

the receptive acquisition of morphosyntactic structures in child L2 English acquisition follows a developmental hierarchy, and that the developmental stages in receptive and productive grammar processing are similar.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the acquisition of receptive grammar skills in L2 children.
the question of whether the acquisition of receptive L2 grammar knowledge follows a systematic order, and if so, whether this order is similar to that observed in L2 productive acquisition.
the acquisition of receptive grammar knowledge and its relationship to the acquisition of productive grammar knowledge.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the present findings support the PT account of L2 grammar development and provide evidence that the same developmental principles apply in receptive as in productive grammar acquisition.

the results of this study support the view that the developmental order of receptive grammar acquisition is similar to that of productive grammar acquisition, but that the two are not identical, with some differences being observed.
the results of this study are in line with the predictions of PT.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the PT framework is able to account for the developmental order of L2 receptive grammar acquisition, as it has already been shown to account for the acquisition of productive grammar knowledge.
receptive grammar acquisition follows the same developmental path as productive grammar acquisition.
PT is able to account for the developmental stages in L2 receptive grammar acquisition.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the PT framework can account for the developmental stages in the acquisition of L2 receptive grammar, and therefore can serve as a basis for a more comprehensive theory of SLA.
receptive data can be used to study developmental systematicity in L2 grammar acquisition.
the PT developmental hierarchy is a valid model for the description of receptive grammar acquisition.
